verdict.rationale: gstack has its own install path: a community commenter describes a git-clone-and-copy install that "works great solo," and the docs mention global vs vendored/project-local installs and a dev-mode symlink into `.claude/skills/`. No quickstart guide, step-by-step onboarding, or timing evidence appears, so the under-five-minutes claim is unsupported. Missing for 10: a documented quickstart or install guide, evidence of time-to-first-working-skill, and hands-on confirmation that a new user reaches a working skill quickly.
